lines.text: Our practice room is closed this Saturday.
lines.speaker: Kit

lines.text: Oh. Could we use the room at the library?
lines.speaker: Ira

lines.text: Yes, but it's only free from three to four.
lines.speaker: Kit

lines.text: I pick up my daughter at three. Is Sunday an option?
lines.speaker: Ira

lines.text: Yes. Sunday the twenty-first, at two or at four.
lines.speaker: Kit

lines.text: Four is better for me. Is that at the library?
lines.speaker: Ira

lines.text: Yes, in Room C on the second floor.
lines.speaker: Kit

lines.text: Got it. Sunday at four, Room C, second floor.
lines.speaker: Ira
